description: List or search the ~200 gaming platforms IGDB tracks — consoles, handhelds, computers, arcade systems and digital storefronts — with abbreviation, hardware generation and platform family. Its ids are what igdb_search_games({ platform_id }) filters on. Example: igdb_platforms({ query: "PlayStation" }).

_apiKey.description: Twitch app credentials as "CLIENT_ID:CLIENT_SECRET" (IGDB is gated by Twitch OAuth). Optional — omit to use the shared Pipeworx credential. Get your own at https://dev.twitch.tv/console.

query.description: Substring of the platform name, e.g. "PlayStation". Omit to list platforms alphabetically.

name: igdb_platforms
title: Igdb Platforms
